title: Revoking a mandated verification after activation does not remove the provider from the assignment pool
actor: Ops staff (role admin, permission providers.manage, not development preview) acting through lib/provider-onboarding-human-activation.ts and lib/provider-verification-mandate.ts; probe executed the real lib functions against node:sqlite D1 shim.
request: 1) readyApplication(boarding) + completeInterviewAndProfile(services:[boarding]); 2) clear all four host mandate checks (aadhaar, pan via runProviderVerification + verified row, house_verification and pet_proofing_photo via recordManualVerification status 'verified'); 3) activateProviderUat(db,{applicationId:'POAPP-BOARDING-1',actorEmail:'ops.one@pawspace.in'}); 4) addProviderToServiceMap(db,{providerId,zoneIds:['blr-east']}); 5) recordManualVerification(db,{applicationId,verificationType:'house_verification',status:'failed',note:'Re-inspection failed: unsafe balcony, dog escaped during visit'}); 6) loadGovernedProviders(db,'blr','blr-east','boarding') and evaluateProviderActivation(db,{applicationId}).
response: activateProviderUat -> {status:'activated_uat', marketplaceLive:false}; addProviderToServiceMap -> {live:true,status:'active'}; recordManualVerification -> {verificationType:'house_verification',status:'failed'}; verificationMandateStatus -> {allVerified:false, canTakeAssignments:false, pending:['house_verification']}; evaluateProviderActivation -> eligible:false with failing check category_verification_mandate {category:'host',pending:['house_verification']}; loadGovernedProviders -> ['host_maya_rohan','host_sana','host_arjun_tara','host_priya_dev','PROV-7A3B3356-9A1'] i.e. the revoked provider IS STILL RETURNED.
d1_before: provider_verifications(POAPP-BOARDING-1): aadhaar=verified, pan=verified, house_verification=verified, pet_proofing_photo=verified. provider_capacity_profiles(PROV-...): live=1, status='active', services_json=["boarding"], zones_json=["blr-east"]. loadGovernedProviders includes the provider.
d1_after: provider_verifications: house_verification status='failed', detail_json={"manual":true,"note":"Re-inspection failed: unsafe balcony, dog escaped during visit"}; others unchanged. provider_capacity_profiles(PROV-...): UNCHANGED - live=1, status='active', services_json=["boarding"], zones_json=["blr-east"]. No provider_unavailability row, no audit/suspension row written.
canonical_failure: recordManualVerification writes only the provider_verifications row and has no path to provider_capacity_profiles, while lib/provider-capacity-governance.ts loadGovernedProviders selects purely on city/live/status/effective dates/services_json/zones_json and never consults provider_verifications, so a host whose mandated house_verification has been revoked to 'failed' is reported 'not eligible' by evaluateProviderActivation while still being returned by the assignment pool.
blast_radius: loadGovernedProviders is the single pool feeder for app/api/uat-scheduling (seedUatRoster + the engine's listEligibleProviders), app/api/training-trainers, lib/universal-replacement-recovery.selectCapacitySafeReplacement and lib/haptik-integration-governance serviceability. A provider whose KYC/house check has been revoked keeps receiving assignment offers and can be auto-selected as a replacement for a live booking. Boarding stay paths (lib/boarding-governance assertHostEligible, lib/boarding-stay-lifecycle assertCapacity) do re-check boarding_host_profiles.kyc_status/home_verified, but those columns are not written by the mandate revocation either, so they do not compensate. There is no de-listing or suspension code path anywhere: nothing in lib/ or app/ sets provider_capacity_profiles.live=0 or inserts provider_unavailability in response to a verification revocation.

title: The automated 'run' path silently overwrites a human's recorded verification FAILURE with 'manual_review' and destroys the inspector's note
actor: Ops staff ops.one@pawspace.in, app_users role_code='admin' (permission providers.manage), authenticated by the product's forwarded-identity header oai-authenticated-user-email against https://ops.pawspace.in, NODE_ENV=production so the development-preview branch of resolveActor was NOT taken.
request: Real route app/api/provider-verification/route.ts POST. Call 1: {"action":"record_manual","applicationId":"POAPP-BOARDING-F51","verificationType":"house_verification","status":"failed","note":"Unsafe balcony; dog escaped during the visit. REJECT."}. Call 2 (same application, same type): {"action":"run","applicationId":"POAPP-BOARDING-F51","category":"host","verificationType":"house_verification"}.
response: Call 1 -> 201 {"data":{"applicationId":"POAPP-BOARDING-F51","verificationType":"house_verification","status":"failed"}}. Call 2 -> 201 {"data":{"applicationId":"POAPP-BOARDING-F51","verificationType":"house_verification","status":"manual_review","automated":false,"providerRef":null}} - no warning, no conflict, no 409.
d1_before: provider_verifications: verification_type='house_verification', status='failed', automated=0, detail_json={"manual":true,"note":"Unsafe balcony; dog escaped during the visit. REJECT."}, updated_by='ops.one@pawspace.in'.
d1_after: provider_verifications: verification_type='house_verification', status='manual_review', automated=0, detail_json={"reason":"Manual/agent verification required (photo or physical check)"}, updated_by='ops.one@pawspace.in'. The recorded failure and the inspector's note are gone from D1; there is no provider verification history table, and the security_audit_events detail for record_manual carries only {verificationType,status}, not the note.
canonical_failure: runProviderVerification's ON CONFLICT(application_id,verification_type) DO UPDATE sets status=excluded.status and detail_json=excluded.detail_json unconditionally, so re-running the automated path over a non-automatable type that a human already resolved replaces the human 'failed' outcome with 'manual_review' and overwrites the inspector's note with the generic 'Manual/agent verification required' string, with no history row anywhere to recover it.
blast_radius: Does not by itself create eligibility: 'manual_review' is still not 'verified', so verificationMandateStatus.allVerified stays false and the activation checklist still blocks. The damage is evidence destruction and misinformation - the failed physical inspection becomes an innocuous 'awaiting review' with no record that the home was ever rejected or why, so the next agent looking at the queue can record 'verified' in good faith and the provider clears the host mandate. Reachable by any providers.manage staff (admin, manager, superuser, founder) through a single POST, and also by an accidental re-run/retry of the same automated action. Same overwrite applies to police_verification and pet_proofing_photo.

title: dog_walking and pet_taxi providers have no verification category; the activation checklist marks the mandate check passed:true and no configuration path exists to add one
risk_category: false KYC / provider eligibility (missing mandate, honestly reported)
actor: Ops staff via lib/provider-onboarding-human-activation.ts (evaluateProviderActivation / activateProviderUat / addProviderToServiceMap) and lib/provider-verification-mandate.ts setCategoryMandate; probe ran the real lib functions.
request: For verticalKey in ['dog_walking','pet_taxi']: readyApplication + completeInterviewAndProfile(services:[vertical]) then evaluateProviderActivation, activateProviderUat, addProviderToServiceMap(zoneIds:['blr-east']), loadGovernedProviders(db,'blr','blr-east',vertical). Separately: setCategoryMandate(db,{category:'walker'|'dog_walker'|'pet_taxi'|'driver',verificationTypes:['aadhaar','pan'],actorId:ops}).
response: verificationCategoryForVertical('dog_walking') -> null and ('pet_taxi') -> null. evaluateProviderActivation returns check {code:'category_verification_mandate',passed:true,detail:{category:null,note:"No verification category mandate is defined for vertical 'dog_walking' - application-level verification only"}} (identical for pet_taxi), eligible:true. activateProviderUat + addProviderToServiceMap succeed; loadGovernedProviders includes the provider for that service. setCategoryMandate for every non-listed category -> throws 'Unknown category (use one of: groomer, pet_sitter, trainer, host)'.
d1_before: provider_verifications: NO ROWS for the application (the table is not even created for a walking/taxi onboarding - the mandate module is never invoked). provider_onboarding_applications.verification_status='verified' (the generic application-level flag).
d1_after: provider_capacity_profiles: live=1, status='active', services_json=["dog_walking"] / ["pet_taxi"], zones_json=["blr-east"]. provider_category_verification_mandates: only groomer/pet_sitter/trainer/host rows; no walker or taxi category can be inserted - setCategoryMandate rejects before any write.
canonical_failure: A dog_walking or pet_taxi provider is activated and put in the assignment pool with zero per-type identity checks: no Aadhaar, PAN, address or police verification is ever required or recorded, because VERIFICATION_CATEGORY_BY_VERTICAL has no entry for those verticals, PROVIDER_CATEGORIES has no walker/driver category, and setCategoryMandate refuses to create one - so the gap is unfixable without a code change.
refutation: The 'fail-open' half of the finding is REFUTED as stated. The checklist's else-branch does return passed:true, but it does not falsely claim a mandate was satisfied: the detail is {category:null, note:"No verification category mandate is defined for vertical '<x>' - application-level verification only"}, which an operator reading the checklist can see. It is an accurately-reported ABSENCE of a mandate, not a silently-passed gate. The remainder of the finding is confirmed by execution: no category exists, and no configuration path can create one (setCategoryMandate validates against PROVIDER_CATEGORIES and threw for walker/dog_walker/pet_taxi/driver; VERIFICATION_CATEGORY_BY_VERTICAL is a module-level const imported only by lib/provider-onboarding-human-activation.ts and is not reachable, readable or writable from any API route).
blast_radius: Every dog_walking and pet_taxi provider in the pool. The ONLY identity gate for them is provider_onboarding_applications.verification_status, which lib/provider-onboarding-transactional.ts createVerification sets to 'not_connected' (IDfy is off) and which becomes 'verified' only when a human calls recordVerificationResult/clearManualVerificationReview - a single staff click with no document, no check type and no per-check evidence row. These are exactly the roles that take a customer's dog alone (walking) or drive it unaccompanied (taxi). Not a code defect that can be patched in configuration: adding a walker/driver category requires editing PROVIDER_CATEGORIES, DEFAULT_MANDATES and VERIFICATION_CATEGORY_BY_VERTICAL in lib/provider-verification-mandate.ts. Also note pet_taxi is not in VERIFICATION_CATEGORY_BY_VERTICAL at all, so lib/provider-onboarding-human-activation.ts verifiedMatchingScope keeps 'pet_taxi' and 'dog_walking' in services_json unconditionally.

title: A fully onboarded, activated, live boarding host is never written into boarding_host_profiles, so boarding discovery can never return them
actor: Ops staff completing the whole real onboarding chain (recordProviderHumanDecision -> createProviderSla -> acceptProviderSla -> saveProviderProfile -> addProviderProfileMedia -> full host verification mandate cleared -> activateProviderUat -> addProviderToServiceMap) plus an unauthenticated customer GET on the public boarding endpoint.
request: 1) Full boarding onboarding for POAPP-BOARDING-1 with all four host mandate checks verified; activateProviderUat then addProviderToServiceMap(zoneIds:['blr-east']). 2) listBoardingHosts(db,{cityId:'blr',zoneId:'blr-east'}); discoverBoardingHosts(db,{cityId:'blr',zoneId:'blr-east',scheduledStart:'2026-09-01T10:00:00.000Z',scheduledEnd:'2026-09-03T10:00:00.000Z',petCount:1,species:['dog']}); GET https://app.pawspace.in/api/boarding-commercial?cityId=blr&zoneId=blr-east&scheduledStart=...&scheduledEnd=...&petCount=1&species=dog via the real app/api/boarding-commercial/route.ts. 3) createMeetGreetRequest(db,{customerId:'CUST-1',hostProviderId:<the real host>,format:'phone',preferredAt:now+1d,intendedStayDays:2}).
response: activateProviderUat -> {status:'activated_uat'}; addProviderToServiceMap -> {live:true,status:'active'}. listBoardingHosts -> ['host_maya_rohan','host_sana','host_priya_dev','host_arjun_tara']. discoverBoardingHosts -> the same four. Customer GET -> HTTP 200 with data.hosts = those same four seeded hosts; the real host is ABSENT (visible:false). createMeetGreetRequest for the real host -> throws 'Host is not a boarding host or pet-sitting provider'; the same call for seeded host_sana succeeds (MGR-...).
d1_before: boarding_host_profiles: only the four hardcoded founder_seed rows (host_maya_rohan, host_sana, host_priya_dev, host_arjun_tara) inserted by ensureBoardingGovernanceTables in lib/boarding-governance.ts.
d1_after: provider_capacity_profiles: the real host is present, live=1, status='active', services_json=["boarding"], zones_json=["blr-east"]. boarding_host_profiles: SELECT * WHERE provider_id=<real host> -> NULL. Still only the four seed rows.
canonical_failure: Nothing in the activation path writes a boarding_host_profiles row, and every boarding surface (listBoardingHosts, discoverBoardingHosts, assertHostEligible, meet-and-greet hostEligible, boarding-stay capacity, boarding-ops replacement, host badges) INNER JOINs or lookups that table, so a fully verified, activated, live boarding host does not exist as far as boarding does.
blast_radius: EXACT BLAST RADIUS: the real host is INVISIBLE, not visible-and-unbookable. The customer sees HTTP 200 and a normal-looking list containing only the four hardcoded seed hosts - there is no error, no empty state, no signal that a real host exists, so the failure is silent for both the customer and the host. Every boarding read path is affected identically because they all join boarding_host_profiles: catalogue (listBoardingHosts), window-aware discovery (lib/boarding-host-discovery.ts), booking eligibility (lib/boarding-governance.ts assertHostEligible would 409 'Selected Boarding host is not active' if a provider_id were supplied directly), stay capacity (lib/boarding-stay-lifecycle.ts assertCapacity), replacement candidates (lib/boarding-ops-governance.ts), host badges (lib/host-badges.ts, which reads medication_support/home_verified/kyc_status from that table) and meet-and-greet (executed: the real host is rejected, a seeded fictional host is accepted). Confirmed by search: the ONLY writers of boarding_host_profiles in the entire repo are the hardcoded founder_seed loop in lib/boarding-governance.ts (line 37) and scripts/uat-demo-seed.sql (lines 192-193). No code path in lib/ or app/ inserts a row for a real onboarded host, and no path writes kyc_status/home_verified either - so at launch 100% of boarding supply shown to customers is fictional seed data and 100% of genuinely onboarded hosts are unreachable and unpayable.
